artifacts.title: Class 65-9WA Presentation Lighter
artifacts.description: Named 1965 Fort Wolters Class 65-9WA presentation lighter with reverse inscription stating the recipient was a member of the first graduating class using the Hughes TH-55A helicopter.
artifacts.condition_summary: Lid opens cleanly; hinge firm; striker wheel turns; insert present; no flint installed; no current spark; not cleaned, fueled, or serviced for operation.

metadata.full_reverse_inscription: PRESENTED TO WOC Arthur P. Lancy, Jr. MEMBER, FIRST GRADUATING CLASS USING HUGHES TH-55A HELICOPTER U.S. ARMY PRIMARY HELICOPTER TRAINING SCHOOL FORT WOLTERS, TEXAS 1965
metadata.front_markings: Class 65-9WA and Hughes World Leader marking
metadata.operation_claim: No operation claim; no flint installed and not cleaned, fueled, or serviced for operation.
metadata.historical_significance: Named Fort Wolters presentation lighter with TH-55A first-graduating-class inscription language, related VHPA class evidence, and later Tropic Lightning News service-context evidence.

physical_object_evidence: Reverse inscription to WOC Arthur P. Lancy Jr.
Reverse inscription states: Member, First Graduating Class Using Hughes TH-55A Helicopter
U.S. Army Primary Helicopter Training School inscription
PARK Lighter / Made in U.S.A. base stamp
vhpa_class_evidence: VHPA WOC Class Pictures Archive index

claim_boundaries: No claim that the lighter was carried in Vietnam
No claim that the lighter was used in combat
